title: Navy memo directs use of ‘super intelligence’ instead of AI
script:
Two words are now effectively banned by the US Navy.
A new internal memo forces all personnel to use super intelligence instead.
Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth is driving this aggressive shift in branding.
This follows a broader directive from the Trump administration to rename military tech.
The change applies to all official documents, briefings, and internal communications immediately.
The mandate aims to align military language with new standards for advanced systems.
Do you think changing a name impacts how the military uses these systems?

LINE 3: Remove Pete Hegseth; the source does not name him as the driver of this specific memo.
LINE 4: Remove the claim about the Trump administration; the source does not support this.
LINE 7: Replace with a more direct question about the terminology shift.
